plugin.name: Yu Zhao · Cultivation Artifact
plugin.description:
## Yu Zhao · Cultivation Artifact

A spirit-sensitive jade artifact laid out as the eight trigrams around the taiji — the taiji core is the heart of Yu Zhao.

**All eight functions unlocked**

- **Life-bound Jade Tablet (Qian)**: name, gender, height, weight, appearance, garments, spiritual root, constitution, realm, status and hidden secrets, synced with the story every turn.
- **Messaging (Dui)**: one-on-one spirit talks and group chats with unread badges.
- **Jade Notes (Li)**: folders and sealed memos.
- **World Forum (Xun)**: cultivation-world posts and comments with echo counts.
- **Market (Zhen)**: goods listings, auction house and trade orders.
- **Nebula Space (Kan)**: spirit stones, coins and stored items.
- **World Map (Kun)**: current location and recent movement tracks.
- **Artifact Mgmt (Gen)**: local system page to seal/unseal functions to save tokens, with sync diagnosis, per-function data clearing and archive export/import.

**Notes**

- Protocol data is hidden from the story text automatically; tap the home sync row or the taiji core for the sync diagnosis page.
- Bagua badges surface sync alerts, unread messages and freshly synced sections; sealed slots show none.
- The floating jade entry is draggable; long-press it or reset it in Artifact Mgmt. It stays hidden outside chat pages.
- UI language follows the app locale; "Prompt language" chooses the language of the injected prompt; sync uses the diff format by default (only +/- changed rows are output), saving tokens.
settings.info: UI language follows the app; seal unneeded features in Yu Zhao Manage to save usage. Manage has sync diagnostics, per-feature clearing, export/import; the sidebar opens Yu Zhao or rebuilds from history. The jade entry is draggable (long-press to reset); hidden outside chat pages. "Prompt language" picks the prompt language; sync uses diff format, sends only recent data, archives older messages to the lorebook "Yu Zhao Archive · <chat>" and recalls them on mention, with a hard usage cap.

releaseNotes.2_1_0:
- Fix: group chats no longer stop showing the latest messages in long conversations — new messages were silently dropped at the cap; the oldest are now trimmed instead, keeping the newest.
- Fix: notebook folder counts were wrong — they are now derived from the actual notes, so adding or deleting notes updates counts automatically.
- Fix: message timestamps no longer use relative words like 今日/昨日 — they must be absolute dates (e.g. 丙午年五月十二 午时), so recalls from history and the lorebook archive are never misled after the story date moves on.
- Fix: old data no longer sticks after plugin updates — when a version change (or seal change) is detected, the next turn automatically rewrites all artifact data under the new rules.
- Fix: regenerating or editing a message no longer wipes the artifact data — when the rebuild source in history was removed by body stripping, the updated data is kept instead of being reset.
- Fix: uninstalling and reinstalling the plugin no longer loses data — state is stored in four tiers (chat-scoped host storage, local mirror, global backup, and a disabled lorebook snapshot entry in "Yu Zhao Archive · <chat>"), and any surviving tier restores it.
- Optimization: much smaller context usage — each turn sends only the most recent messages/notes/posts (older items appear as "archived" summaries), and when the chat mentions a person or group, their full archived history is recalled on demand from an auto-managed lorebook ("Yu Zhao Archive · <chat>", viewable in settings).
- Cap: total injected data per turn has a hard limit, so usage no longer snowballs as data grows.
